error: Enabled memory_transfer was intercepted by the inherited End2End controller before the cross-task Host gate.
preservation: Pod, runtime, data, output, logs, RUN_OUTCOME, and attempt identity are retained and must not be reused.
root_cause: StageAwareHybridMemoryLayer.retrieve_for_node returned through end2end_controller before checking the memory_transfer role. The actual run therefore opened the legacy five-granularity Search Agent instead of constructing the deterministic score-free transfer pack.
wrapper_termination: SIGTERM during the legacy retrieval request and before candidate code execution
